item.description:
### Added - **Factory's Droid CLI.** Perch now shows your `droid` sessions on the Mac: - which ones are working, with the tool and how long the turn has run, which need you for a permission, and which have finished; - the model, effort and context used, and jump-to-terminal for each.
Perch adds its hooks and a small status line to Droid's settings, next to any hooks you already have. If you had your own status line, it still shows, and it's put back if you remove Perch. `droid exec` runs are not shown. Droid rows on the iPhone and Apple Watch come with the next app update.
### Fixed - **Amp: sessions started with `--executor`, `--attach`, `--title`, `--runner-dir` or `--project` can be replied to again.** Perch read the option's value as a command and treated the session as one it couldn't type into.
